H2600.def: gratis, i.e. devoid of cost, reason or advantage
H2600.kjv: without a cause (cost, wages), causeless, to cost nothing, free(-ly), innocent, for nothing (nought, in vain.

H2601.derivation: probably by orthographical variation for H2606 (חֲנַנְאֵל);

H2603.def: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition)
H2603.kjv: beseech, [idiom] fair, (be, find, shew) favour(-able), be (deal, give, grant (gracious(-ly), intreat, (be) merciful, have (shew) mercy (on, upon), have pity upon, pray, make supplication, [idiom] very.

H2605.def: Chanan, the name of seven Israelites

H2606.derivation: from H2603 (חָנַן) and H410 (אֵל); God has favored;
H2606.def: Chananel, probably an Israelite, from whom a tower of Jerusalem was named

H2607.def: Chanani, the name of six Israelites

H2608.derivation: or חֲנַנְיָהוּ; from H2603 (חָנַן) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has favored;
H2608.def: Chananjah, the name of thirteen Israelites

H2610.def: to soil, especially in a moral sense

H2614.def: to be narrow; by implication, to throttle, or (reflex.) to choke oneself to death (by a rope)

H2616.def: properly, perhaps to bow (the neck only in courtesy to an equal), i.e. to be kind; also (by euphemistically, but rarely) to reprove
H2616.kjv: shew self merciful, put to shame.

H2617.def: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H2617.kjv: favour, good deed(-liness, -ness), kindly, (loving-) kindness, merciful (kindness), mercy, pity, reproach, wicked thing.

H2619.derivation: from H2617 (חֵסֵד) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has favored;

H2620.def: to flee for protection; figuratively, to confide in

H2621.def: Chosah, an Israelite; also a place in Palestine

H2623.kjv: godly (man), good, holy (one), merciful, saint, (un-) godly.

H2624.def: the kind (maternal) bird, i.e. a stork

H2627.derivation: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H2637 (חָסֵר);

H2629.def: to muzzle; by analogy, to stop the nose

H2630.def: properly, to (be) compact; by implication, to hoard

H2635.derivation: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to that of H2636 (חַסְפַּס);

H2636.derivation: reduplicated from an unused root meaning apparently to peel;

H2637.def: to lack; by implication, to fail, want, lessen
H2637.kjv: be abated, bereave, decrease, (cause to) fail, (have) lack, make lower, want.

H2638.kjv: destitute, fail, lack, have need, void, want.

H2643.derivation: from H2653 (חׇפַף) (in the moral sense of covered from soil);

H2644.def: properly, to cover, i.e. (in a sinister sense) to act covertly

H2645.def: to cover; by implication, to veil, to encase, protect

H2648.def: properly, to start up suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, to fear

H2651.derivation: from an unused root of uncertain signification;

H2654.def: properly, to incline to; by implication (literally but rarely) to bend; figuratively, to be pleased with, desire
H2654.kjv: [idiom] any at all, (have, take) delight, desire, favour, like, move, be (well) pleased, have pleasure, will, would.

H2655.kjv: delight in, desire, favour, please, have pleasure, whosoever would, willing, wish.

H2656.def: pleasure; hence (abstractly) desire; concretely, a valuable thing; hence (by extension) a matter (as something in mind)
H2656.kjv: acceptable, delight(-some), desire, things desired, matter, pleasant(-ure), purpose, willingly.

H2657.derivation: from H2656 (חֵפֶץ) with suffixes; my delight (is) in her;
H2657.def: Cheptsi-bah, a fanciful name for Palestine

H2658.def: properly, to pry into; by implication, to delve, to explore

H2659.derivation: a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as H2658 (חָפַר) through the idea of detection);
H2659.def: to blush; figuratively, to be ashamed, disappointed; causatively, to shame, reproach
H2659.kjv: be ashamed, be confounded, be brought to confusion (unto shame), come (be put to) shame, bring reproach.

H2660.derivation: from H2658 (חָפַר) or H2659 (חָפֵר); a pit of shame;
H2660.def: Chepher, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites

H2661.derivation: from H2658 (חָפַר); a hole; only in connection with H6512 (פֵּרָה), which ought rather to be joined as one word, thus חַפַרְפֵּרָה; by reduplication from H2658 (חָפַר);
H2661.def: a burrower, i.e. probably a rat

H2662.def: a Chephrite (collectively) or descendants of Chepher

H2664.def: to seek; causatively, to conceal oneself (i.e. let be sought), or mask
H2664.kjv: change, (make) diligent (search), disquise self, hide, search (for, out).

H2666.def: to spread loose; figuratively, to manumit

H2667.def: something spread loosely, i.e. a carpet

H2669.derivation: and חׇפְשִׁית; from H2666 (חָפַשׁ); (with H1004 (בַּיִת), a hospital)

H2671.derivation: from H2686 (חָצַץ); also by interchange for H6086 (עֵץ)
H2671.def: properly, a piercer, i.e. an arrow; by implication, a wound; figuratively, (of God) thunderbolt; the shaft of aspear
H2671.kjv: [phrase] archer, arrow, dart, shaft, staff, wound.

H2672.def: to cut or carve (wood, stone or other material); by implication, to hew, split, square, quarry, engrave
H2672.kjv: cut, dig, divide, grave, hew (out, -er), made, mason.

H2673.def: to cut or split in two; to halve
H2673.kjv: divide, [idiom] live out half, reach to the midst, participle

H2674.derivation: a collective form of H2691 (חָצֵר); village;
H2674.def: Chatsor, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine and of one in Arabia

H2675.derivation: from H2674 (חָצוֹר) and a Aramaizing form of the feminine of H2319 (חָדָשׁ) (compare H2323 (חֲדָת));
H2675.def: new Chatsor, a place in Palestine

H2676.derivation: from H2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה;

H2677.derivation: from H2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה;
H2677.kjv: half, middle, mid(-night), midst, part, two parts.

H2679.derivation: from H2677 (חֵצִי) and the plural of H4496 (מְנוּחָה), with the article interposed; midst of the resting-places;

H2680.def: a Chatsi-ham-Menachtite or descendant of Chatsi-ham-Menuchoth

H2682.derivation: perhaps originally the same as H2681 (חָצִיר), from the greenness of a courtyard;

H2683.derivation: from an unused root meaning to hold firmly;
H2683.def: the bosom (as comprised between the arms)

H2684.derivation: a collateral form of H2683 (חֵצֶן), and meaning the same

H2685.def: properly, to shear or cut close; figuratively, to be severe

H2686.derivation: a primitive root (compare H2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה); also as denominative from H2671 (חֵץ)
H2686.def: properly, to chop into, pierce or sever; hence, to curtail, to distribute (into ranks); to shoot an arrow
H2686.kjv: archer, [idiom] bands, cut off in the midst.

H2687.def: properly, something cutting; hence, gravel (as grit); an arrow

H2688.derivation: or חַצֲצֹן תָּמָר; from H2686 (חָצַץ) and H8558 (תָּמָר); division (i.e. perhaps row) of (the) palm-tree;

H2689.def: a trumpet (from its sundered or quavering note)

H2690.derivation: a primitive root; properly, to surround with a stockade, and thus separate from the open country; but used only in the reduplicated form חֲצֹצֵר; or (2 Chronicles 5:12) חֲצֹרֵר; as dem. from H2689 (חֲצֹצְרָה);
H2690.def: to trumpet, i.e. blow on that instrument

H2691.derivation: (masculine and feminine); from H2690 (חָצַר) in its original sense;
H2691.def: a yard (as inclosed by a fence); also a hamlet (as similarly surrounded with walls)

H2692.derivation: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H146 (אַדָּר); (the) village of Addar;

H2693.derivation: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and a feminine of H1408 (גַּד); (the) village of (female) Fortune;

H2694.derivation: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H8484 (תִּיכוֹן) with the article interposed; village of the middle;

H2695.derivation: by an orthographical variation for H2696 (חֶצְרוֹן); enclosure;

H2696.def: Chetsron, the name of a place in Palestine; also of two Israelites

H2697.def: a Chetsronite or (collectively) descendants of Chetsron
